PsgcRegister.//: ADR-005 gate 1. The PSA's site refuses automated download — measured 2026-09-15, psa.gov.ph returned 403 to two clients, the classification API's endpoints returned 400, and nap.psa.gov.ph no longer resolves. A browser session reaches the publication; a script does not. So an operator downloads the workbook and sets the four values below, after which one command completes the gate.
PsgcRegister.//LocalFileIsPsaPublication: true — the declaration that this file is a PSA publication. Nothing infers it: a file on disk carries no provenance, and guessing would let a mirror be presented as the authority.
PsgcRegister.//LocalFilePublicationDate: 2026-06-30 — the date the PSA states the edition is as of, not the download date.
PsgcRegister.//LocalFileAcquisitionNote: Downloaded from psa.gov.ph/classification/psgc in a browser session on 2026-09-15.
PsgcRegister.//LocalFileWorksheet: PSGC — the masterlist sheet, if the workbook's first sheet is a cover page.
